worldcombat.skill.painsplit.summary: Tie a thread of pain between you and the target, add both totals of life and split them evenly: the lower side is filled up, the higher side drained, and both keep at least one point. Whoever is healthier pays.
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.use.0: Level the gap when your life is far below the foe's
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.use.1: Drain a slice from a high-health target
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.use.2: Trade your own life to drag the foe down to your level
Tie a thread of pain to an enemy target within %1$s blocks with a clear line to you, and split the combined life evenly.
Tie the thread in %1$s, gather it in %2$s after the split, and a %3$s cooldown from commit.
Both sides meet the same average: the foe may be healed and you may be drained. It can never be fatal - both are held to at least 1 point of life.
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP to tie the thread, then %3$s seconds to gather it in and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.growth.0: At level %1$s the thread reaches %2$s blocks and the cooldown becomes %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.growth.1: At level %1$s the thread reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.painsplit.preference.a: Only tie the thread within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
The target's current life must exceed yours by this much (scaled by the larger of the two maximums) before it ties the thread. Higher is pickier about the gap; lower casts more often.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to tie the thread. Off: it only casts when the target is already in reach.
